stories.headline: Warhammer Survivors launches November 10 with more than 40 playable champions
stories.summary: Auroch Digital's officially licensed bullet-heaven action game is scheduled for PC and other platforms on November 10. Built in partnership with Warhammer and Vampire Survivors creator poncle, it brings characters from Warhammer 40,000 and Age of Sigmar into wave-based battles with more than 40 playable champions and over 70 weapons. A free Steam demo is available ahead of the full release.

stories.headline: Ashes of the Singularity II arrives November 10 with three rival factions
stories.summary: Oxide Games and Stardock Entertainment's large-scale sci-fi RTS is scheduled to launch on PC on November 10. The sequel adds the human United Earth Forces alongside the AI Substrate and Post-Human Coalition. Its battles focus on managing thousands of units, logistics and shifting terrain, with a single-player campaign as well as online co-op and competitive multiplayer.

stories.headline: Football Manager 27 is set for its November 10 PC release
stories.summary: Sports Interactive and Sega list November 10 as the release date for Football Manager 27 on Steam. The football-management simulation returns with club management, tactical decision-making and squad building. Its Steam listing also confirms online multiplayer, and notes that the PC version uses Denuvo anti-tamper DRM.

stories.headline: Nocturnal 2 brings hand-drawn Metroidvania exploration to PC on November 10
stories.summary: Sunnyside Games has scheduled its hand-drawn action adventure Nocturnal 2 for November 10 on Steam. Players explore the interconnected city of Ytash with a flame-powered sword, unlock abilities that reveal new routes, and discover hidden endings. The game's Steam listing confirms full controller support.

stories.headline: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered returns November 10 with four-player co-op
stories.summary: Aspyr is bringing its updated version of the classic Shrek 2 adventure to Steam on November 10. The remaster features rebuilt textures, 4K support, revised cutscenes, a Photo Mode and Cheat Mode. Players can explore Far Far Away alone or in up to four-player couch, online or mixed co-op.

stories.headline: Final Fantasy XIV Patch 7.58 opens regional matchmaking across European and North American data centers
stories.summary: Square Enix's Patch 7.58 expands Duty Finder, Party Finder, Crystalline Conflict ranked matchmaking and other social functions across all logical data centers within the same physical region. European players on Chaos and Light can now find parties together without switching data centers. The patch also strengthens the Echo in AAC Heavyweight (Savage) and removes several weekly reward restrictions.

stories.headline: Monster Train 2: The Punished introduces a self-damage-focused clan on November 10
stories.summary: Shiny Shoe's new DLC for Monster Train 2 adds The Punished, a clan led by returning character Archus and new champion Zariel. Its risk-reward mechanics include Punish effects triggered by friendly damage, and a Monolith that converts sacrificed cards into Devotion and Zeal buffs. The expansion is scheduled to release on PC and consoles November 10, and requires the base game.

stories.headline: Phasmophobia charity event raises over $200,000 and unlocks animated player rewards
stories.summary: Kinetic Games' Ghost Hunts for Hearts fundraiser surpassed $200,000 for the American Heart Association, exceeding the campaign's previous record. Players can log in before November 15 to claim an animated AHA Advocate ID Card and Badge unlocked by the community's fundraising milestone. The campaign also included an event-themed Twitch Drop.

stories.headline: Steam now shows real-world Steam Deck frame rates on game store pages
stories.summary: Valve has begun displaying opt-in player performance data for Steam Deck on Steam store pages. For games tested for Deck compatibility, including Verified, Playable and Unsupported titles, users can open the Steam Deck Compatibility details to see average frame rates and a histogram of observed performance. The figures provide a clearer indication of how games actually run on LCD and OLED Deck models before buying.

stories.headline: Thief: The Dark Project Remastered brings back Stephen Russell as Garrett
stories.summary: Nightdive Studios has confirmed that Stephen Russell is returning to voice master thief Garrett in The Tarnished Mirror, the new narrative campaign included with Thief: The Dark Project Remastered. Russell discussed his history with the character in a new Nightdive interview. The remaster launches on PC on December 3 and includes original Thief and Thief Gold material alongside the new campaign.

stories.headline: PlayStation Plus is ending PC cloud streaming on December 10
stories.summary: Sony has announced that it will retire the PlayStation Plus app for PC on December 10, removing the ability to stream PlayStation Plus games through that Windows app. Sony says fewer than 0.4% of eligible Premium members use it. PlayStation Plus subscriptions and benefits on PS5 and PS4 are unaffected.

stories.headline: BioWare veterans discuss reuniting to revive Mass Effect and Dragon Age
stories.summary: BioWare co-founder Trent Oster is exploring whether former developers could reunite around the studio's dormant franchises after EA's closure of BioWare. Former creative director James Ohlen publicly welcomed the idea of working on Dragon Age again. Oster says access to the intellectual property and funding are major hurdles; there is no announced acquisition, revived studio or confirmed new game.

stories.headline: Big Walk developer discloses limited LLM use and plans AI policy
stories.summary: House House has added an AI-use disclosure to its official Big Walk FAQ after debate involving Independent Games Festival jurors. The developer says LLMs were used sparingly to troubleshoot technical issues near the end of development, and estimates that well under 0.1% of the game's code was related to that work. It says generative AI was not used elsewhere in production and plans to establish a formal internal policy.
